The scene is dominated by several large, elongated, and irregularly shaped soap bubbles floating above the figures. The bubbles exhibit strong iridescent rainbow coloration (pinks, greens, blues) and reflectivity, contrasting with the desaturated background. One bubble appears to be merging with or floating directly over a person's head.
